title: Malignant type (Gestational Trophoblastic neoplasia—GTN)
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS

blocks.text: GTNs are highly sensitive to chemotherapy, with cure rates approaching 95%. Cure is possible even in metastatic disease. All patients with GTN should be referred to a gynecologic oncologist for a careful pre-treatment evaluation (proper staging and risk stratification) as well as for definitive management.
